reconstruction.note: Reconstructed from the Horizon - Capacity Analytics screenshot supplied by the user on 2026-09-20. The original input bundle is not on this machine, so this must never be cited as an original baseline.

displayOnlyOmissions.policy: Only values legible in the screenshot are stored. The Utilization % line on the by-year chart could not be read at exact precision and is omitted; nothing may be inferred about it from the After.

truncatedLabels.policy: Project names are truncated in the source screenshot. The reconstruction keeps the truncated display labels verbatim; no full names are invented and nothing is rendered all-ellipsis.

budgetThreshold.finding: No field definition, sidecar, or legible source statement establishes what the 100% budget level means for this dataset.
budgetThreshold.policy: Descriptive output only. Over-100% usage gets no salience beyond what routed roles already grant and must never be encoded as red/critical/warning/attention framing.

periodBasis.finding: The source does not state whether the 2026 point is a full year or a partial year to date.
periodBasis.policy: The trend subtitle discloses that the basis is not stated. No year-over-year decline interpretation is permitted.

valueAudit.projectTopValue: 415% is the top bar of the by-project chart (10 bars).
valueAudit.departmentHrValue: 415.39% is the HR row of the by-department table (8 rows).
valueAudit.finding: Two independent source values from two different charts; no row/column misalignment in the reconstruction.

avgMetricBasis.finding: The denominator of Avg Hours Logged (per person? per project? per team?) is not stated anywhere in the source.
avgMetricBasis.policy: The KPI tile detail discloses that the average basis is not stated in the source.

unitPresentation.policy: Percent-semantics values are stored and displayed with the % suffix so title, display, and source semantics agree (415%, 115.91%). The portfolio KPI 117% matches the table total 116.86% within display rounding.

notEstablishedBySource: any specific project or department is the problem
polarity.policy: Descriptive output only. The After must not frame over-100% budget usage as alerts, breaches, or priorities without target/policy/benchmark evidence.
